Definition: Overall cohort: 152 genomes. Primary reference-group comparisons: 144 genomes (23 subflava, 114 perflava, 7 flavescens). Eight species-unresolved genomes are descriptive only.
Species names denote operational reference assignments. ANI_reference_assignment records the ANI reference channel; analysis_group additionally accounts for unresolved species status.
ANI values are percentages; AF is a proportion. The perflava channel uses the better of two CCUG 17915 assemblies. ANI margin is in percentage points.
subflava: GCA_005221305.1; perflava: GCA_023472875.1 / GCA_042649725.1; flavescens: GCA_005221285.1. GGDC Formula 2 uses the first perflava assembly.

The 1,303-record ledger uses final exclusion decisions: 327 ANI candidates, 243 source/QC-eligible records, 169 dereplicated representatives, and 152 retained genomes. Margins are supplied for the 169 representatives.
Counts summarize grouping of the same 243 eligible genomes at 5, 10, 20 and 50 SNPs, before the final unique-reference filter; they are not alternative final main-cohort sizes.

Blank/NR denotes unavailable or unreported information, not biological absence. Participant and unit identifiers are study-scoped; 152 units are not asserted to be fully independent epidemiological observations.
